_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Arthur W. Ryder (1877-1938), Berkeley Sanskritist: Kalidasa, the Little Clay Cart, the Panchatantra, the Bhagavad-gita, Twenty-two Goblins. All first published 1905-1929: US public domain (pre-1931). Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 10); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_surname_note: Never the bare 'ryder' (an English word and a common surname).

ryder-kalidasa: Translations of Shakuntala and Other Works

ryder-kalidasa-shakuntala-and-other-work.work: Translations of Shakuntala and Other Works

ryder-panchatantra.scan_edition: University of Chicago Press, 1925 (raw OCR). The imprint reads 'Published September ... Second Impression October / Third Impression December' with the year garbled; the record says 1925, and the run of three impressions in four months fits that. Not panchatantra0000arth (sixth impression, 1955).

_name_words_note: Translator name only: fetch_shelf.py treats it as the identity check, so the original author's name is deliberately NOT listed.
_verified_note: Evidence that each source's rights/identity line was read (lane C review fix, 2026-10-02, pipeline run over the fetched files; no book text recorded). PG: the header's Translator: line and the COPYRIGHTED marker. IA: whether the translator's name appears in the first 30 KB of OCR, and the years printed in the first 15 KB of front matter (scanner/digitizer lines skipped). Any post-1930 year there was examined by eye; see the title's scan_edition.
